entries.017afd66f371ca52: In 1840, Iwakichi Kashima set up a shop under the trade name "Oiwa" near present-day Kyobashi, Chuo-ku, Tokyo. The company regards this as its founding. It specialized in construction work on daimyo residences, such as the Edo residence of Matsudaira Echizen no Kami, and after the opening of the country it handled many Western-style buildings.
entries.037d6a04b405df26: In November 1986, it established Kajima U.S.A. Inc. Based in Atlanta, that company oversees subsidiaries in North America and elsewhere and handles investment and financing for affiliates. Under it are construction companies such as Hawaiian Dredging Construction Company, The Austin Company, Batson-Cook, and Flournoy Construction Group.
entries.05383c0d51a79c44: KAJIMA CORPORATION forms a group with 219 subsidiaries and 106 affiliated companies. The parent has business headquarters for civil engineering, building, development and others, which formulate strategy, while domestic affiliates handle the sale of construction materials, specialized construction, leasing and building leasing, and overseas affiliates carry out construction and development businesses in North America, Europe, Asia and Oceania. The reportable segments are five: civil engineering, building, development and others, domestic affiliates, and overseas affiliates, and a feature is that the [[term:segment|segment]] division combines the parent's business divisions with the affiliates' regional divisions.
